remarks: How about a luxury spa retreat to call home? Experience elevated living in this fully reimagined condominium, meticulously renovated from the studs up with uncompromising attention to detail. From the laser cut room dividers to the SmartHome features you can have it all. Designed for both sophistication and comfort, the residence features triple-insulated walls and ceilings, upgraded 220V electrical service, new plumbing, and quality construction throughout. Premium cork-backed flooring flows seamlessly across the space. The bespoke Wren kitchen is a true statement, showcasing custom whisper-close cabinetry with integrated storage solutions, quartz countertops, porcelain backsplash, and an oversized peninsula with dual-side storage access. High-end appliances include a Thermador induction cooktop, app connected Monogram wall oven, dishwasher, refrigerator, and exhaust fan. Built-in cabinet outlets, dedicated microwave space, wine refrigerator accommodation, and concealed waste storage reflect thoughtful, modern design. The spa-inspired bath offers heated tile floors, a quartz vanity, designer tile work, and an upgraded coated glass shower enclosure for a refined retreat experience. Additional luxuries include app-controlled heating, adjustable ELFA closet systems, custom plantation shutters, new ceiling fans with remotes, and tailored storage solutions throughout. Centrally located to everything, this turnkey residence delivers effortless, contemporary luxury in every detail.
